mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index predicts higher expected future interest rates, which reduces the present value of equity cash flows, thereby lowering S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Over 60-day rolling window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a constant mean (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS labor cost index coincides with higher wage growth expectations, which raises the cost of capital and dampens equity valuation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In regimes with rising PAYEMS, 60-day forward returns are positive more than 40% of the time (p < 0.05 two-tailed test).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST industrial production exceeds its prior month by more than 2%, it signals robust demand momentum that supports higher corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: Over 100 instances where HOUST crosses the +2% threshold, 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO supply index exceeding 1% suggests tight supply conditions, which can raise risk premia and compress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: During INDPRO declines >1%, 20-day forward returns are positive in over 70% of cases (p < 0.01).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4%, the increased policy rate is expected to discount future cash flows more heavily, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In 100 instances where FEDFUNDS crosses above 4%, 20-day forward returns are not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE (unemployment) above 4% for three consecutive months is associated with weaker wage growth expectations and lower equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: During such UNRATE regimes, 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in both GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their prior month's levels indicate accelerating economic momentum, which tends to boost investor confidence and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In 200 instances with both proxies rising, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls by more than 3% in a month, it signals supply-side weakness that raises uncertainty and risk aversion, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: During such INDPRO drops, 5-day forward returns are positive in over 50% of cases (p < 0.05).
